object_description: main hall volume with a lateral layer of small rooms under a widely cantilevered roof, plus a square social building
geometry_property: main volume with lateral room layer
more pronounced projection to the east
design_condition: the new building addresses the street and takes space right up to the school while subordinating itself through eaves height and expression, creating an extended arrival and meeting square between them

positive: The contribution proposes a simple yet far-sighted setting for the centre of the community
The address is lined up on the street and continues the sequence of elevated situations beautifully
It makes a self-confident appearance while subordinating itself to the school through eaves height and expression
This creates an extended arrival and meeting square
The precise positioning of the square social building creates clear references to the church and the everyday centre
The open spaces are preserved and further developed in their own way
The main volume faces the school and is also oriented to the street with its spacious foyer
A layer of small rooms connects the volume to the public space and the school courtyard
The stage area opens across the all-weather square to the large southern open space
The halls and auditorium open onto the new square
A grid defines the facade on all sides and emphasises versatility for school and public use
The external timber facade is structurally protected by the cantilevered roof on all sides
The cantilevered roof has an integrative and inviting effect
The more pronounced eastern projection emphasises the newly invented place for cultural and everyday life
A contrasting grid on the second building promises a beautiful interplay
The flat pitched hipped roof is visually very restrained
All required uses are fulfilled with a clear building organisation
The stage system complies with the brief and the southern opening offers exciting open-air possibilities
The new structure of the open spaces is pleasantly simple and convincing in its functionality
The garage ramp appears as an elongated piece of furniture and integrates the covered bicycle parking
The playground at the southern end of the square is convincingly placed
Tree plantings complement the existing cemetery fringe into a continuing canopy space
Preserving the old copper beech is a very convincing solution requiring no new root zone interventions
The basement levels are minimised and the floor plans kept simple and rational
Hall and social building can be implemented in stages or independently
The compact design with a comparatively small volume has a positive effect on construction costs
The project translates the far-sighted concept of the 1940s building into a convincing project for today
It reinforces what is already there without pandering to it
negative: No further information is available on the facade details and materialisation of the second building
Simplifications in the standard are accepted in favour of the clarity of the organisation
The kitchen has a direct connection to the auditorium but not to the foyer
The elongated walk-through foyer only gives access to the spectator areas for large events
If the hall is used separately, access is only possible from outside on the east side
The clarity of appearance and situation requires concessions for individual operational processes and comfort
